Sandbox_WanderingZombies_ChanceDropdown_:
%AAAAFFStatic%FFFFFF: The value chosen below is always used.
%AAAAFFRandom%FFFFFF: A random value from Min to Max (inclusive) is used. The value is randomised when the period of activity is calculated.

If Min is greater than Max, Max will be used as the minimum.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_WanderChanceMin:
Chance that zombies will move randomly.

%FF0000Increase this value to increase difficulty%FFFFFF.
%00FF00Decrease this value to decrease difficulty%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_HomingChanceMin:
Chance zombies will %DDDD00move towards the player%FFFFFF.
Zombies that are homing do not constantly have their path updated to your current position.

%FF0000Increase this value to increase difficulty%FFFFFF.
%00FF00Decrease this value to reduce difficulty%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_FleeChanceMin_t:
Chance zombies will %AAAAFFmove away from the player%FFFFFF.

%00FF00Increase this value to decrease difficulty%FFFFFF.
%FF0000Decrease this value to increase difficulty%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_ChanceMax_toolt: This is only used if %AAAAFFChance: Mode%FFFFFF is set to %AAAAFFRandom%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_StartHourDropdo:
%AAAAFFStatic%FFFFFF: The value chosen below is always used.
%AAAAFFRandom%FFFFFF: A random value from Min to Max (inclusive) is used. The value is randomised when the period of activity is calculated.

Min is allowed to be greater than Max, so ranges over midnight can be used.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_WanderStartHour:
The hour at which random wandering can start.
0 is midnight (12:00am).
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_HomingStartHour:
The hour at which homing can start.
0 is midnight (12:00am).
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_FleeStartHourMi:
The hour at which fleeing can start.
0 is midnight (12:00am).
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_StartHourMax_to: This is only used when %AAAAFFStart Hour: Mode%FFFFFF is set to %AAAAFFRandom%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_TotalHoursDropd:
%AAAAFFStatic%FFFFFF: The value chosen below is always used.
%AAAAFFRandom%FFFFFF: A random value from Min to Max (inclusive) is used. The value is randomised when the period of activity is calculated.

If Min is greater than Max, Max will be used as the minimum.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_TotalHoursMin_t:
This is added to Start Hour to calculate the period of activity.

%AAAAFFExamples%FFFFFF:
%AAAAFF24/7%FFFFFF: Start Hour 0, Total Hours 24
%AAAAFF6am to 6pm%FFFFFF: Start Hour 6, Total Hours 12
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_TotalHoursMax_t: This is only used when %AAAAFFTotal Hours: Mode%FFFFFF is set to %AAAAFFRandom%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_CooldownHoursDr:
%AAAAFFStatic%FFFFFF: The value chosen below is always used.
%AAAAFFRandom%FFFFFF: A random value from Min to Max (inclusive) is used. The value is randomised when the period of activity is calculated.

Min is allowed to be greater than Max, so ranges over midnight can be used.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_CooldownHoursMi:
The amount of time that must elapse before the next period of activity.
If this value is not set to a multiple of 24, or is randomised to a value that is not a multiple of 24, the remainder is used to adjust Start Hour for that period of activity.
For example, if Start Hour is set to 0 (12:00am), and Cooldown Hours is set to 26, the next Start Hour would be 2am.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_CooldownHoursMa: This is only used when %AAAAFFCooldown Hours: Mode%FFFFFF is set to %AAAAFFRandom%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_Destructive_too:
%AAAAFFAlways%FFFFFF: Zombies will always attack objects in their path.
%AAAAFFIndoors%FFFFFF: Zombies considered indoors will attack objects in their path.
%AAAAFFNever%FFFFFF: Zombies will not attack objects in their path.
%AAAAFFRandom%FFFFFF: Randomly select one of the above, when the period of activity is calculated.

The vanilla destruction settings do NOT have an effect on this setting.
Setting this value to %FF0000anything other than %AAAAFFNever %FF0000increases difficulty%FFFFFF.

Recommended setting is %AAAAFFAlways%FFFFFF:
- It increases the ambiance.
- It makes undamaged houses valuable.
- It opens more paths for zombies to use.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_MoveCooldown_to:
The static amount of time (milliseconds) before a zombie can move.
Only applies to lone zombies and leaders of a horde, followers in a horde move when the leader does.

The cooldown is reset whenever a zombie is considered busy:
- While a zombie is moving (vanilla wandering is ignored)
- While a zombie has a target (character, dead body or thumpable)

%00FF00Increase this value to reduce difficulty%FFFFFF.
%FF0000Decrease this value to increase difficulty%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_MoveCooldownRan:
The maximum random value added to %AAAAFFCooldown%FFFFFF.
This value is randomised again during the resets mentioned in Cooldown's tooltip.

%00FF00Increase this value to reduce difficulty%FFFFFF.
%FF0000Decrease this value to increase difficulty%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WZHordeZombie_MoveCooldownHordeS:
This value is multiplied by the size of the horde before being added to the result of the above settings.

%00FF00Increase this value to reduce difficulty%FFFFFF.
%FF0000Decrease this value to increase difficulty%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_MaxTravel_toolt:
The maximum random distance that can be used.
This is used by Wandering, Homing and Fleeing.

This value is used to select a location, which is passed to the game's pathfinding.
The %DDDD00resulting path may be longer%FFFFFF than this value when needing to path around buildings, fences, etc.

High distance paired with Out Of Cell Paths results in increased local migration.
Low cooldowns with a low to mid distance results in zombies changing direction more frequently.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_RadiusDropdown_:
%AAAAFFStatic%FFFFFF: The value chosen below is the value that is always used.
%AAAAFFRandom%FFFFFF: A random value from Min to Max (inclusive) is always used. The value is randomised when the current period of activity has elapsed.

If Min is greater than Max, Max will be used as the minimum.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_HomingRadiusMin: Zombies that are at least this distance from the player are allowed to use the homing settings.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_FleeRadiusMin_t: Zombies that are up to this distance from the player are allowed to use the flee settings.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_RadiusMax_toolt: This is only used when %AAAAFFRadius: Mode%FFFFFF is set to %AAAAFFRandom%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_HomingRadiusInt:
%AAAAFFOn%FFFFFF: Homing zombies that are within the Homing Radius are told to stop homing.
%AAAAFFOff%FFFFFF: Homing zombies are free to complete their path.
%AAAAFFRandom%FFFFFF: Randomly selects %AAAAFFOn%FFFFFF/%AAAAFFOff%FFFFFF when the period of activity is calculated.
Sandbox_WanderingZombies_FleeRadiusInter:
%AAAAFFOn%FFFFFF: Fleeing zombies that are outside the Flee Radius are told to stop fleeing.
%AAAAFFOff%FFFFFF: Fleeing zombies are free to complete their path.
%AAAAFFRandom%FFFFFF: Randomly selects %AAAAFFOn%FFFFFF/%AAAAFFOff%FFFFFF when the period of activity is calculated.
Sandbox_WZHordeZombie_Hordes_tooltip: When enabled (checked), Wandering Zombie's horde features will turn on.
Sandbox_WZHordeZombie_WorldAgeHours_tool: Hordes will not start to form until the world is at least this old.
Sandbox_WZHordeZombie_HordesMerge_toolti: When enabled (checked), hordes can join together to become a single, bigger horde.
Sandbox_WZHordeZombie_MergeCooldown_tool:
The amount of time that must pass before a horde is allowed to merge.
This value is multiplied by the number of followers in a horde.

%00FF00Increase this value to reduce the speed at which hordes grow in size%FFFFFF.
%FF0000Decrease this value to increase the speed at which hordes grow in size%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WZHordeZombie_HordeSize_tooltip:
The largest size a horde can grow to.
When merging is enabled, this is ignored.
%AAAAFFSet this value to 0 to allow hordes to be of any size.%FFFFFF
Sandbox_WZHordeZombie_HordeLimit_tooltip:
The maximum number of hordes that are allowed to exist.
In multiplayer, this is per player.
%AAAAFFSet to 0 to disable.%FFFFFF
Sandbox_WZHordeZombie_CreateJoinMergeDis:
The maximum distance at which zombies will create/join/merge hordes.

%FF0000Increase this value to increase the speed at which hordes form/grow%FFFFFF.
%00FF00Decrease this value to to decrease the speed at which hordes form/grow%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WZHordeZombie_LeaveDistance_tool:
Zombies that are at least (Leave Distance + Create/Join/Merge Distance) away from the horde will leave the horde.
%FF0000Set this to 0 to prevent zombies from leaving hordes%FFFFFF.
%DDDD00Increase this value to increase the average size of hordes%FFFFFF.
%00FF00Decrease this value to decrease the average size of hordes%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WZHordeZombie_GroupBySpeed_toolt:
When enabled (checked), zombies can only join hordes that match their speed.
Only reads the speedType variable, so mods that alter the animation speeds and do not correctly set the zombie's speedType to match will conflict.

%DDDD00This option requires the mod Reflection Enabler, and will be forcefully disabled without it.%FFFFFF
Sandbox_WZHordeZombie_AllowSprinters_too:
When enabled (checked), sprinters are allowed to be in hordes.

%DDDD00This option requires the mod Reflection Enabler.
Without the Reflection Enabler:
- All zombies are considered Fast Shamblers.
This option is forcefully disabled.%FFFFFF
Sandbox_WZHordeZombie_AllowFastShamblers:
When enabled (checked), fast shamblers are allowed to be in hordes.

%DDDD00This option requires the mod Reflection Enabler.
Without the Reflection Enabler:
- All zombies are considered Fast Shamblers
- This option is forcefully enabled.%FFFFFF
Sandbox_WZHordeZombie_AllowShamblers_too:
When enabled (checked), shamblers are allowed to be in hordes.

%DDDD00This option requires the mod Reflection Enabler.
Without the Reflection Enabler:
- All zombies are considered Fast Shamblers.
- This option is forcefully disabled.%FFFFFF
Sandbox_WZHordeZombie_AllowCrawlers_tool:
When enabled (checked), crawlers are allowed to be in hordes.

%DDDD00This option requires the mod Reflection Enabler.
Without the Reflection Enabler:
- All zombies are considered Fast Shamblers.
- This option is forcefully disabled.%FFFFFF
Sandbox_WZShared_MoveCooldownInitial_too:
When enabled (checked), the move cooldown is applied to a zombie the moment Wandering Zombies becomes aware of it.
This will %DDDD00prevent zombies immediately moving%FFFFFF the moment they load in. (From starting/loading a game, moving around the world, being teleported (Admin / RV Interiors)).
Sandbox_WZShared_OutOfCellPaths_tooltip: When enabled (checked), zombies are allowed to select a path that leads to them walking out of the loaded area / active cell.
Sandbox_WZShared_OutOfCellThreshold_tool: Only allow Out Of Cell Paths when the number of zombies exceeds this value.
Sandbox_WZShared_WanderForwards_tooltip:
When enabled (checked), the random location chosen for wandering will be locked to a position +/- 45 degrees in the direction the zombie is facing.
If enabled, recommend either turning off %AAAAFFOut Of Cell Paths%FFFFFF, or increasing %AAAAFFOut Of Cell Threshold%FFFFFF.
Since this still chooses a random location and passes it to the game's finding, %DDDD00zombies won't necessarily move forwards%FFFFFF due to fences, buildings, etc.
Sandbox_WZShared_RoomExploreLimit_toolti:
Maximum random number of times a zombie will select a room from the building they're in to explore.
Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_WZShared_ForcedExploreChance_too:
Chance that a zombie passing through a building will stop, and explore it.
Zombies that come to a stop inside a building will always explore, as long as exploring is enabled.
Sandbox_WZShared_RepeatExplore_tooltip: When enabled (checked), a zombie that has finished exploring will start exploring again if they are not on the ground floor.
Sandbox_WZShared_DumbZombiesExplore_tool:
When enabled (checked), all zombies are allowed to explore.
When disabled (unchecked), only smart zombies are allowed to explore.

%DDDD00This option requires the mod Reflection Enabler.
Without the Reflection Enabler:
- All zombies are considered dumb.
- This option is forcefully enabled.%FFFFFF
Sandbox_WZShared_ExploreDestructive_tool: When enabled (checked), exploring zombies will destroy objects in their path.
Sandbox_WZShared_ForcePathfind_tooltip:
%AAAAFFNever%FFFFFF: Let the game decide when pathfinding should be used.
%AAAAFFIndoors%FFFFFF: Attempt to force pathfinding for indoor zombies.
%AAAAFFAlways%FFFFFF: Attempt to force pathfinding for all zombies.
Sandbox_WZShared_HoursSurvived_tooltip: The minimum amount of hours a player needs to of survived before zombies will be able to use the player as a target of homing.
Sandbox_WZShared_ChebyshevDistance_toolt:
When enabled (checked), Wandering Zombies will use Chebyshev for distance instead of Euclidean.
Chebyshev measures distance in a square.
Euclidean measures distance in a circle.
Chebyshev distance may slightly improve performance.
Sandbox_WZPerformance_ZombieProcessLimit:
The number of zombies that Wandering Zombies performs an update on each frame.
This does not limit the amount of zombies Wandering Zombies has control over, as the update continues where it stopped on the last frame.
You should not need to change this value.
Sandbox_WZPerformance_SandboxVarsUpdateF:
Controls the frequency (milliseconds) of Wandering Zombies updating it's Sandbox Options.
Time periods and destruction are also calculated during this update.
You should not need to change this value.
Sandbox_WZDirector_PullEnabled_tooltip: When enabled (checked), allows the director to randomly pull zombies to a random location around the player, inside a radius, when the player has been unseen for a period of time.
Sandbox_WZDirector_PullUnseenTime_toolti:
Player must remain unseen for this period of time before the director can begin pulling zombies, and shrinking the radius.
Value is in in-game minutes.
Sandbox_WZDirector_PullMinRadius_tooltip:
The smallest the radius can be.
Every in-game minute while you remain unseen, after the unseen time limit has been reached, the radius decreases by 1% of Max Radius.
Sandbox_WZDirector_PullMaxRadius_tooltip:
The starting and maximum size of the radius.
Upon being seen, the radius reverts to this value.
Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateEnabled_toolti:
When enabled (checked), allows the director to send out world sounds to attract distant zombies to a random location around the player.
%DDDD00This event is currently hardcoded to be disabled in MP%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateDistance_toolt:
This value determines how large of an area to give to the world sound.
Make sure to adjust the vanilla option Zombie Follow Distance to match.
Zombies inside a 120 radius of the world sound's location ignore the sound.
%DDDD00Setting this value too high can cause performance issues%FFFFFF.
Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateZombieThreshol: The director will only send out the world sound when there are less than this many active zombies.
Sandbox_WZDirector_MigrateCooldown_toolt:
Time required to pass before the Migrate Event can trigger.
The cooldown is constantly refreshed while the number of zombies is at, or above the %AAAAFFZombie Threshold%FFFFFF.
Value is in in-game minutes.
